name: multi-workspace-document-assistant
description: Multi-workspace RAG document assistant with tool calling (React + Node + Firebase Auth + Firestore vector search + Gemini)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
